task: Continue generic PIO State Mapper validation after Debug Probe connection
problem: The State Mapper pipeline had PASS-BUILD evidence but no target-connected proof because the Debug Probe was previously disconnected.
affectedSubsystem: OpenOCD/GDB validation, RP2350 PIO Multi-Pin Input, generic CPU/FIFO pipeline, State Mapper PIO output
rootCause: Validation availability only; no production defect was discovered.
correctiveAction: Programmed the exact visible-MainWindow generated ELF through CMSIS-DAP probe E66258881776372E using OpenOCD target/rp2350.cfg with program, verify and reset. Observed source capture, normalized state, pipeline state, PIO FIFO status and PIO pad output through GDB. Used documented RP2350 GPIO INOVER fields to apply internal test states to GPIO20-GPIO22, preserving the real PIO input path; saved and restored all original control registers before resuming the target.
verificationResult: PASS-ON-TARGET for deterministic logical state mapping. 000 produced normalized state 0, pattern 0 and padout 0; 001 produced state 1, pattern 1 and GPIO8 padout 0x100; 010 produced state 2, pattern 2 and GPIO9 padout 0x200; unmapped 011 and 111 returned pattern/padout 0. PIO output-enable evidence was 0x3f00 for GPIO8-GPIO13, firmware cycle count advanced, RX FIFO was consumed, and OpenOCD reported Verified OK. Break-Before-Make PIO assembly and generated 2 us timing remain build/assembler verified; the short inactive interval was not measured with an oscilloscope or logic analyzer, so no external timing claim is added. No production code changed, no commit/push occurred, and OpenOCD/GDB were shut down gracefully.

task: Formally close Hall/PWM V1 before V2 work
milestone: Hall/PWM V1 closed baseline ready for V2 development
problem: Hall/PWM V1 was functionally complete and physically validated but administratively incomplete; the final UI regression also exposed a separate Viewer-to-Components selection synchronization defect.
affectedSubsystem: Hall/PWM V1 validation, Viewer-to-Components UI synchronization, AR&MF baseline control plane
rootCause: The semantic componentNodeSelected event reached MainWindow::selectComponentFromViewer, but the handler required GL hit-test resolution even when the stable catalog node was already known. In the offscreen semantic test, node 124 therefore resolved to no selectable item and Wireless remained selected instead of Debug. Hall/PWM itself was not implicated.
correctiveAction: Restored stable catalog-node precedence in selectComponentFromViewer, preserved the existing selection recursion guard, and made the explicit Debug mapping own its shared model node. Corrected only the separately demonstrated metadata defect by completing catalog information for mapper profile/output/PWM choices and adding numeric examples for PWM frequency and duty. No cpu_fifo, PwmEnableTarget, PWM waveform, PIO mapping, DMA, pio_gate_enable, or Hall/PWM architecture changes were made.
verificationResult: Hall/PWM V1 Implementation: COMPLETED. Functional On-Target Validation: PASS-ON-TARGET. Safe State Validation: PASS-ON-TARGET. Generated Build: PASS: PIO assembly, CMake configure, Ninja, ELF and UF2. Regression: PASS, 17/17, 736.75 seconds test time and 736.8 seconds wall time; project_system_verification completed normally in 633.07 seconds. Final ELF generated_wireless.elf SHA-256 CC9D4319C302ED3A746E017E56FFF4AED92F1C0048C68AB0FDD0B185F697AE17 was programmed, verified and reset through CMSIS-DAP v2 probe E66258881776372E serial E66258881776372E. Hall GPIO20-22 used PIO0/SM0; PWM GPIO8-13 used the six configured PWM resources at 25 kHz and 50 percent duty. Observed mapping masks were 000=0x00, 001=0x09, 010=0x12, 011=0x18, 100=0x24, 101=0x21, 110=0x06, 111=0x00. PWM remained internally enabled and GPIO override fields matched active/inactive mask bits. Baseline: PASS. V1 contract is frozen with cpu_gpio_override backend, cpu_fifo transport, hardware PWM responsibility, safe state 000000, invalid/unmapped OFF, and pio_gate_enable reserved but not implemented. Physical timing certification is DEFERRED: suitable oscilloscope or logic analyzer unavailable. Break-Before-Make physical 2 us timing measurement, cpu_fifo end-to-end latency, and cpu_fifo jitter remain deferred. V2 is not started; readiness note records pio_gate_enable prerequisites only. No commit or push occurred.
